description: Physical binding between two biomolecules (drug-target, protein–protein, ligand–receptor).
signature: binds_to(actor, target, affinity, [residues_actor, residues_target, via, confidence])

description: Up- or down-regulates the catalytic or signalling activity of an enzyme, pathway node, or transcription factor.
Increases or decreases mRNA abundance of a single gene or predefined gene signature.
Assembly or disassembly of a multi-subunit protein complex (including stoichiometry changes).
Molecular or pathway change that induces a measurable cellular phenotype or disease trait.
Action that reverses or ameliorates an abnormal phenotype back toward healthy state.
Non-causal functional similarity based on embeddings or phenocopy fingerprints.
Statistical association without established causality (e.g., GWAS, literature co-mention).
Annotates an entity as a member of a GO term, pathway, or cellular compartment.
Variant or edit that increases the normal activity of a protein.
Variant, knock-down, or knock-out that abolishes or reduces protein activity.
Post-transcriptional control at the ribosome level, altering protein output from existing mRNA.
Site-specific chemical modification or proteolytic processing of a protein.
Translocation of a molecule between sub-cellular compartments (includes secretion if to='extracellular').
Enzymatic conversion of one molecule into another (metabolic or proteolytic).
Alters protein abundance by affecting half-life (e.g., ubiquitination, PROTAC action).
Ligand-receptor communication between two cell types and the immediate intracellular outcome.
signature: cell_cell_interaction(sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, outcome, [via, confidence])
